summary: Three stable tests (15, 40 and 250 ms) whose cost never changes on any target.
Noisy but unchanged test: carrier rate lookups take U(55..105) ms on every run of every commit.
Unchanged test with a heavy tail present from the start: 60 ms, but 5% of runs take 300 ms (cold model load). Outliers are seeded per run; their positions are in expected-durations.csv.
Ten sub-millisecond tests of pure domain logic (Money, Sku). Their durations are dominated by timer resolution and JIT; relative changes are meaningless.
Real CPU-bound work (SHA-256 over 32 MB) that never changes. Its absolute duration depends on the runner CPU, so only stability matters.
60 small unchanged tests with log-normal baselines (0.2-200 ms). Twelve of them have constant per-OS cost factors (Windows x1.4, macOS x0.8). Every alert on them is a false positive.

Sudden large step on every target: 3 ms → 500 ms at commit 60 (invoice rendering starts embedding four font files). A no-op refactoring of the same class at commit 57 is a decoy for culprit detection.

summary: Linear creep on every target: every commit ≡ 1 (mod 4) between 17 and 105 adds a checkout validation rule costing 4 ms, so the test drifts 30 → 122 ms over 23 small steps with no single culprit.

Accelerating creep driven only by data: every commit ≡ 3 (mod 4) between 3 and 119 adds six rows to the embedded tax jurisdiction table, whose loader checks every pair of rows for overlaps. Cost 2 + 0.0045·n(n-1)/2 ms grows from about 4 ms (30 rows) to about 101 ms (210 rows), faster towards the end.

Slow creep below the per-commit noise on every target: every commit ≡ 3 (mod 4) between 31 and 79 adds a shipping label field costing 3 ms, so the test drifts 200 → 239 ms in 13 steps (each step about half the run-to-run noise).
Gradual improvement on every target: every commit ≡ 1 (mod 4) between 33 and 89 stops pre-warming one legacy image rendition (8 ms each), so the test improves 200 → 80 ms in 15 steps.

Regression hidden in a gap: the test is skipped at commit 10 (TRX outcome NotExecuted). Commit 12 makes the code 50 → 110 ms on every target while nobody measures it. The test is re-enabled at commit 16. The culprit is commit 12, not 16; any window [12, 18] is acceptable.
